title: Regression: unable to eagerly fetch related entity on base class through polymorphic join

labels.name: loader options
labels.description: ORM options like joinedload(), load_only(), these are complicated and have a lot of issues

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

body:
Similar to #5082, except the relationship is defined on the parent class, as opposed to the child class.

Bisect shows introduced between `rel_1_3_0b2` and `rel_1_3_0b3`.

Reproducible test case:

``` python
from sqlalchemy import (
    Column,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    MetaData,
    String,
    create_engine
)
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import (
    backref,
    joinedload,
    relationship,
    Session,
    with_polymorphic,
)


Base = declarative_base()


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)


class Foo(Base):
    __tablename__ = "foos"
    __mapper_args__ = {"polymorphic_on": "type"}

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    type = Column(String, nullable=False)
    owner_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    owner = relationship("User", backref=backref("foos"), cascade="all")
    bar_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("bars.id"))
    bar = relationship("Bar", backref=backref("foos"), cascade="all")


class SubFoo(Foo):
    __tablename__ = "foos_sub"
    __mapper_args__ = {"polymorphic_identity": "SUB"}

    id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("foos.id"), primary_key=True)


class Bar(Base):
    __tablename__ = "bars"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)


class Fred(Base):
    __tablename__ = "freds"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    bar_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("bars.id"))
    bar = relationship("Bar", backref=backref("freds"), cascade="all")


engine = create_engine("sqlite://")
metadata = MetaData()
with engine.begin() as connection:
    metadata = Base.metadata
    metadata.create_all(connection)

session = Session(bind=engine)

# Setup some related entities
user = User()
bar = Bar()
fred = Fred(bar=bar)
sub_foo = SubFoo(owner=user, bar=bar)
session.add_all([fred, bar, sub_foo])
session.commit()

foo_polymorphic = with_polymorphic(Foo, "*", aliased=True)
foo_load = joinedload(User.foos.of_type(foo_polymorphic))

query = session.query(User).options(
    foo_load.joinedload(foo_polymorphic.bar).joinedload(Bar.freds)
)
assert "freds" in str(query), str(query)
print("ok")
```
